resolution: CONVERGED at pass 2. Trust-page audit (Phase B), 2026-08-30. Drafted and fixed in an Opus session; both hostile passes run as independent Sonnet subagents against the code and data, each told to re-derive every number itself rather than trust the generated site-facts sheet. PASS 1 returned BLOCK on one error and five warnings. The error: the page claimed the two quote stores do not overlap at all, sourced to a site-facts line reading '0 of 432'. The verifier re-derived 21. Root cause was a keying bug in scripts/generate-site-facts.js (cache.bills is an array, so the per-bill lookup was keyed on the index and missed every time); the generator was fixed and the real figure, 21 of 432, is now in the prose. Also fixed from pass 1: the granule identifier is not merely unlinked but never read by any front-end code, so the prose now says what a quote card actually renders; the Senate-matcher comparison, the bill-page store's renderer and the floor-quote bill link all gained ledger rows. PASS 2 returned PASS: no contradicted or unsupported claim, all 40 receipts verbatim and probative, and every count independently re-derived to an exact match including the 21.
notes:
WHAT CHANGED FROM THE LIVE PAGE. The unqualified sitewide promise ('We do not quote press releases. The text shown is verbatim from the primary source.') was scoped to member quotes, because tracker articles cite organisation and member positions from the documents their holders published - data/ref-sources.json registers a press-release-kind source. The verifier was asked specifically whether that narrowing is honest or a dodge and concluded it is accurate scoping: two different real gates. 'We store these granule identifiers with each quote' was false for the bill-page store (0 of 417) and only 430 of 468 true for the floor store; 'we link back to the source granule when available' was false everywhere - no front-end file reads the field. The C-SPAN 'authoritative verbatim source' claim and the 'covers all floor proceedings (C-SPAN doesn't)' comparison were unsourced and are removed; the revise-and-extend caveat is now bound to CRS 98-265. The speaker-resolution paragraph now states what resolveRepInfo actually does, including that it takes the first remaining candidate rather than refusing to guess. OPEN, NOT FIXED HERE: articles/legislationpatch-and-ai.html and articles/what-is-congressional-record.html carry the same false granule and session claims; both are drafted in this same batch.

2026-09-02 WRAP-UP DELTA. data/ref-text/record-lp-site-facts.txt was regenerated at the end of the article audit sweep, having been held deliberately stale through it (the corpus grew 219 -> 222 bills, the article-ledger count 17 -> 48, and the vote store gained a roll call). 1 receipt(s) on this ledger were repointed to the regenerated line, each new span verified present in the new sheet, and the prose was corrected in the same pass wherever a number moved. No claim was added or removed; nothing was softened.
